description: This file defines various exception classes related to Orleans transactions, including base and specific exceptions for transaction failures, overloads, aborts, and other transaction-related errors within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionException
classes.description: Base class for all transaction exceptions in Orleans, inheriting from OrleansException.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionsDisabledException
classes.description: Indicates that Orleans transactions are disabled.

classes.name: OrleansStartTransactionFailedException
classes.description: Signifies failure to start a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionOverloadException
classes.description: Indicates that the transaction runtime is overloaded.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionInDoubtException
classes.description: Indicates that the runtime cannot determine whether a transaction has committed.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionAbortedException
classes.description: Indicates that a transaction has been aborted, with a TransactionId property.

classes.name: OrleansCascadingAbortException
classes.description: Indicates that a transaction was aborted due to a dependent transaction aborting, with a DependentTransactionId property.

classes.name: OrleansOrphanCallException
classes.description: Indicates that a transaction was aborted because a method did not await all its pending calls.

classes.name: OrleansReadOnlyViolatedException
classes.description: Indicates that a read-only transaction attempted to write to a grain.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionServiceNotAvailableException
classes.description: Indicates that the transaction service is not available.

classes.name: OrleansBrokenTransactionLockException
classes.description: Indicates that a transaction was aborted due to a broken lock detection.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionLockUpgradeException
classes.description: Indicates failure to upgrade a lock during a transaction.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionPrepareTimeoutException
classes.description: Indicates that the transaction was aborted due to a timeout during the prepare phase.

classes.name: OrleansTransactionTransientFailureException
classes.description: Indicates a transient failure during a transaction, such as internal timeouts or protocol issues.

methods.name: GetObjectData
methods.description: Overrides for serialization support in exception classes, adding TransactionId or DependentTransactionId as needed.
